title: Christmas Cake Dip Cups
creator: Cozy Christmas Recipes
cookTime: Heat-treat cake mix at 350°F to 165°F; chill until serving
ingredients: ¼ cup red and green Christmas sprinkles (plus extra for topping)
instructions: Heat-treat the cake mix: spread the dry mix on a baking sheet and bake at 350°F, stirring occasionally, until it reaches 165°F throughout. Let cool completely.
Beat softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth and fluffy.
Gradually mix in the cooled cake mix and heavy whipping cream until creamy.
Gently fold in the whipped topping until light and smooth.
Fold in the red and green sprinkles.
Spoon or pipe the mixture into mini dessert cups.
Top with extra sprinkles and refrigerate until ready to serve.
